description: Return the Merkle audit path that ties one FORUM trust record to the daily release root: leaf, index (0-based leaf position), path (sibling hashes, leaf level first) and root. Same object as GET /v1/trust/{registry_name}/proof on the FORUM HTTP API. Verification recipe: (1) h = the 32 bytes of `leaf` (hex-decoded; `leaf` is the record's content_sha256), i = `index`. (2) For each hex sibling s in `path`, in order: if i is even, h = sha256(h + s_bytes); if i is odd, h = sha256(s_bytes + h); then i = i // 2. (3) hex(h) must equal `root`. Then compare root with merkle_root from get_method and with the on-chain anchor (method doc section 10.2); a root taken only from this response shows internal consistency, not publication. A valid proof shows that the record is part of the published release; it says nothing about whether the scored server is safe. A score is: Not a security guarantee, not a penetration test, not certification of code correctness. An unknown name returns isError with error=not_in_registry. Read-only.

registry_name.description: MCP Registry server name, exactly as the registry spells it: owner/name, e.g. io.github.pipeworx-io/19hz. Contains a slash; pass it raw (no URL-encoding). Case-sensitive.
